integrity: Complete definitions and proof are provided with an independently constructed finite enumeration checker; finite enumerations are corroborative, not a proof of the infinite-field/general-generator theorem. No external mathematical validation or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Reduced ideal loci only: no scheme-theoretic reducedness claim; no general component-intersection classification; the cubic-cone model concerns the four-dimensional ideal locus for two generators. Finite verification covers five small prime-field configurations. Historical publication priority is not established conclusively.
title: Ideal Grassmann bundles of free cube-zero local algebras and a twisted-cubic-cone boundary
